Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41511 of 2024

Applicant :- Masoom Raza
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Aishwarya Pratap Shahi,Parijat Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Shri Shatrughan Yadav, learned A.G.A. for the State apprise the Court that on 28.10.2024 notice has been served to the informant.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant to oppose this application for bail.

2. Heard Shri Parijat Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Shatrughan Yadav,
learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in S.T. No.361 of 2021 arising out of Case Crime No.125 of 2021, under Sections 376-D, 147, 323, 504, 506, 34 I.P.C.,
Sections 5/6 POCSO Act, Section 67 I.T. Act and Sections 3(2)(V) S.C./S.T. Act, Police Station Vishunpura, District Kushinagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that however, there was allegation that applicant Masoom Raza vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137987121/
1 alongwith co-accused Noor Mohammad, Isha Ansari, Shaukat and Muzahid committed rape upon the daughter of the informant aged about eleven years but during trial when informant of the case and victim appeared before the trial court then they did not support the prosecution case and both have been declared hostile and their statements recorded by trial court have been annexed alongwith the instant bail application.
5.

entities.text: Masoom Raza vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that co-accused Noor Mohammad, Isha Ansari, Shaukat and Muzahid have already been released on bail by this Court and their bail orders have been annexed alongwith the instant bail application.
He further submits, on merit, case of applicant is at par with them.

6. He further submitted that however, apart from the present case, applicant is having criminal history of a case under the provisions of U.P. Gangsters Act but in that case, on the basis of present case, he has been made accused and except present case and case under the provisions of U.P.
Gangsters Act, applicant is having no other criminal history.
7.
He further submits that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 13.06.2021 i.e. for last more than three years.
8. Per contra, learned AGA however opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the arguments on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
9. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Considering the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant and the fact that informant and victim both during trial have been declared hostile as they did not support the prosecution case and four co-accused have already been released on bail and on merit, case of applicant is at par with them and applicant is having no previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 13.06.2021 i.e. for last more than three years, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant- Masoom Raza, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Masoom Raza vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137987121/
2

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
13. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

14. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
